review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H3 demonstrate a localized maintenance and behavior correction. P1.F1.H1 adds HTTPS and URL validation messages and updates error mappings, while P1.F1.H3 changes URL validation error handling to return specific HTTPS or invalid URL messages instead of raw errors. This is a substantive, bounded improvement in user-facing error handling and configuration
